Absolutely. Here’s the simple version:

• Classic watch: just tells the time and focuses on style. No app, no charging, no subscription.
• Smartwatch: connects to your phone for notifications, activity tracking, sleep, heart rate, and more.
• Sport watch: a smartwatch with extra fitness focus. Better if you want training features and GPS.
• Kids smartwatch: made for children, with fun features and parent controls.
• Kids GPS watch: the safety-focused option for children, with real-time GPS, calls, messages, and safe zones. This one needs a €7.99/month subscription.
